title: The due-date card
logline: His own strips in a library folder, and in its pocket a due-date card with three stamps: 2004, 2011, 2019. Somebody checked him out. Three times. The names blank.

panels.composition: Close on a manila folder's inside pocket with a library due-date card in it, three date stamps in purple ink — years apart — and the borrower lines rendered blank. The folder's tab: FINCH, A. (LOCAL).

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a library folder's pocket holding a due-date card with three purple date stamps years apart and blank borrower lines, a typed tab reading a surname, no words
image.notes: Letter after: the stamps 2004 · 2011 · 2019; tab FINCH, A. (LOCAL). Borrowers reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Checked out three times. Names blank.
